Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GS.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.32 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 102 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2020.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.32 per share.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 829 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Revenue guidance of $35.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
